Headline: Cross-system predictor architecture is strongly conserved.
Evidence: Full14 mean cosine range 0.936–0.955; all Aitchison permutation p=.0001.

Headline: Conserved architecture contains structured continuous international heterogeneity.
Evidence: CLR-PCA is multidimensional; cross-outcome distance structures differ; macro context and subtype reweighting explain portions of this heterogeneity.

Headline: The original predictor set is a stable backbone, not an exhaustive predictor set.
Evidence: Expanded predictors improve prediction while Core14/Core17 renormalized architecture remains near-identical.

Headline: Dominant associations are directionally conserved but their magnitudes vary systematically across international context.
Evidence: 20/30 GDP/region moderator tests robust after FDR and sensitivity analysis; indirect association negative in 74/74 systems.
InterpretationStatus: Primary moderation; exploratory noncausal indirect association
